# StatsOverlayMode

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Diagnostics` · enum

```csharp
public enum StatsOverlayMode
```

Selects the on-screen stats overlay's content and the level of measurement performed by the underlying collector.

## Remarks

Higher modes carry more measurement overhead. Choose the lowest mode that gives you the information you need; in shipped builds the overlay is typically off entirely.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="off"></a>`Off = 0` | Overlay hidden; collector is fully suspended. Every collection hook is a single predictable branch (no Stopwatch reads, no allocations). This is the default. |
| <a name="fpsonly"></a>`FpsOnly = 1` | Single-line on-screen overlay showing only frames per second. The collector takes exactly one `Stopwatch.GetTimestamp` reading per frame; update/draw split and framework/app breakdown are not measured. |
| <a name="detailed"></a>`Detailed = 2` | Four-line on-screen overlay showing FPS, update time (framework/app), draw time (framework/app), and GPU draw calls and sprites per frame. Carries the full bracket-based measurement cost on every framework call site. |
